data.name: Emulation.Emulator.o2em.Description
data.value: Emulates Magnavox Odyssey² and Philips Videopac G7000 consoles.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.o2em_bios.Help
data.value: Select the console hardware and its BIOS.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.o2em_region.Help
data.value: Select the television standard, or detect it from the console model.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.o2em_swap_gamepads.Help
data.value: Swap the input ports of the two console controllers.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.o2em_vkbd_transparency.Help
data.value: Set the transparency of the on-screen keyboard.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.o2em_crop_overscan.Help
data.value: Remove unused borders around the game image.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.o2em_mix_frames.Help
data.value: Blend successive frames to reduce flicker.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.o2em_audio_volume.Help
data.value: Set the volume produced by the emulated console.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.o2em_voice_volume.Help
data.value: Set the volume of speech produced by The Voice accessory.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.o2em_low_pass_filter.Help
data.value: Reduce high audio frequencies to soften the sound.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.o2em_low_pass_range.Help
data.value: Set how strongly the filter reduces high audio frequencies.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.m2000_keyboard_mapping.Help
data.value: Match the host keyboard by character or by key position.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_video_standard.Help
data.value: Select the television standard used by the CD-i player.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_read_config.Help
data.value: Load the configuration saved by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_write_config.Help
data.value: Save the configuration in the native emulator format.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_saves.Help
data.value: Name saved states by game or by emulated system.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_nvram_saves
data.value: Separate persistent saves for each game

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_nvram_saves.Help
data.value: Keep a separate persistent memory file for each game.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_auto_save.Help
data.value: Restore a saved state at startup and save the state when closing.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_boot_from_cli.Help
data.value: Use the native emulator command-line startup mode.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_mame_paths_enable.Help
data.value: Use the paths configured in the native MAME configuration.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_alternate_renderer.Help
data.value: Use the alternate video rendering method provided by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_altres.Help
data.value: Select the output resolution of the alternate rendering method.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_mouse_enable.Help
data.value: Enable mouse input in the emulated player.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_lightgun_mode.Help
data.value: Select how pointing input is passed to the light gun.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_buttons_profiles.Help
data.value: Use the button profile supplied by the emulator for the current game.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_mame_4way_enable.Help
data.value: Restrict joystick directions using the native four-direction modes.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_throttle.Help
data.value: Let the emulator limit execution to the normal machine speed.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_cheats_enable.Help
data.value: Enable the cheat codes supported by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Philips.Option.same_cdi_cpu_overclock.Help
data.value: Set the CPU clock as a percentage of its original speed.
